assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, HISAT2, DESeq2), mouse gastrocnemius (GC), soleus (SOL), C2C12 myotubes
sequenced_sample_sets: Basal GC and SOL, F/F (ChREBP-flox) vs ChMKO (Mck-cre), n=5/group (S3.2.p2, Figure 3/S3)
Hypoxia 2 weeks vs normoxia, F/F and ChMKO GC, n=4/group (S2.3.p1, S3.4.p4-p5, Figure 5E-F)
Long-term high-fructose diet (3 months), F/F and ChMKO GC, n=4/group (S2.4.p1, S3.4.p7-p8, Figure 5G)
AAV-ChREBP vs AAV-CON GC at 14 dpi after cardiotoxin, n=5/group (S3.3.p2, Figure 4E-F)
C2C12 ChREBP overexpression vs vector, day 7 differentiation, n=4/group (S3.5.p2, Figure 6D-I)
exercise_component: Exercise appears only as a phenotypic readout: exhaustive weighted swimming test (S2.5) with plasma LDH/lactate at rest vs post-exercise (S3.1.p4, Figure 2D-E). No exercised muscle was sequenced; none of the GEO samples is an exercise or post-exercise sample.
primary_estimand: Paper's transcriptomic estimands are genotype (ChMKO vs F/F), hypoxia vs normoxia, HFrD vs chow, AAV-ChREBP vs AAV-CON, and Ch-OE vs vector. There is no exercise estimand in the RNA-seq.
planned_contrasts: Hypo_F/F vs Norm_F/F; Hypo_ChMKO vs Hypo_F/F; Hypo_ChMKO vs Norm_ChMKO (S3.4.p4-p5; Figure 5F)
HFrD_F/F vs Norm_F/F (S3.4.p8; 483 DEGs); Hypo_F/F vs Norm_F/F (187 DEGs) (S3.4.p8)
C2C12 Ch-OE vs CON day 7 (S3.5.p2; 224 up DEGs)
paper_method: DESeq2, no multiple-testing correction, |log2FC| >= 1 and p < 0.05 (S2.13.p1)
